entry.summary: The wealth of nations has been a shared obsession among economists, sociologists, philosophers, and political theorists throughout history. But historical evidence and empirical data tell us the relationship isn't nearly that straightforward—in fact, it's often misleading. entry.title: Authority Placement: Control Layers and Enforcement Boundaries
entry.summary:
Context
A Kong gateway plugin was implemented to reject API requests violating a contract rule (len(values) ≤ n) before they reach upstream services. Enforcement is placed at the gateway layer, preventing invalid requests from entering downstream execution paths. In distributed systems, enforcement can occur at multiple layers. The critical distinction is whether enforcement prevents execution or reports failure after the fact. A control layer is one where invalid actions are stopped before execution. This differs from validation layers, which detect violations after the action has been attempted and report the failure. The invariant: Enforcement placed after execution is reporting, not control. "May this action proceed?" "Was this action invalid?" These questions are not interchangeable…

entry.title: NiceHaus, a household-managing AI-powered web app
entry.summary: Hey, would you mind taking a look at my app and telling me what you think? I'd really appreciate it. nicehaus.fooorms.com (fooorms.com is another app I made). My gf and I are living together since july last year, and have been splitting expenses equally. So we keep a google sheets document where we enter everything each one of us pays for, and if one is lagging behind, that person has to pay for the next few things to catch up. But I don't like manually writing the entries, and sometimes I put it off so long that I forget some expenses :'v Same thing happens to her, although not as often. So I created NiceHaus (Haus because she teaches German) to be able to enter expenses through voice prompts, and also shopping list items, and to-do list items. You say, "I bought eggs for 3 dollars, Lucía bought some sheets for 20, and we have to paint the kitchen wall", the app records you, Anthropic's Haiku 4.5 parses the transcription into manageable json, it gets saved, and the frontend organizes and shows it. So yeah, I'd appreciate your comments and suggestions :)

entry.title: Anthropic launches Cowork, a Claude Desktop agent that works in your files — no coding required
entry.summary: Anthropic released Cowork on Monday, a new AI agent capability that extends the power of its wildly successful Claude Code tool to non-technical users — and according to company insiders, the team built the entire feature in approximately a week and a half, largely using Claude Code itself. The launch marks a major inflection point in the race to deliver practical AI agents to mainstream users, positioning Anthropic to compete not just with OpenAI and Google in conversational AI, but with Microsoft's Copilot in the burgeoning market for AI-powered productivity tools.
